Tank tops: extra coverage, same light feel

Wider shoulder straps make a tank top warmer than a camisole and easier to wear on its own. It sits neatly under blouses, jumpers and jackets, and works as an everyday base layer all year.

For the coldest days, step up to a long-sleeve top or turtleneck.
